changes.text:
What changed vs. the current page

1. Slim header, empty bag, headline + price + Shop button first
2. Proof bar: trial, shipping, handmade, gift-ready
3. Mission moved up, beside the products
4. Compact grid with Day/Glow toggle, filters, Add
5. Builder folded into one Custom & Corporate section
6. Real reviews only (placeholders until collected)
7. FAQ open on the page
8. One email band, one enquiry form

[Brackets] = facts to fill in. Grey photo tags = shoot real photos.
